body:
Success status codes other than 0 aren't really expected. We expect Godot to be the only one initializing the .NET host and that should only happen once. It feels weird to change the initialization to accept a scenario we don't support.

However, I think it's fine to make this change since they're not exactly failure status codes, so we may as well be more forgiving. The only thing I would want is to at least log it somewhere (at least when verbose logging is enabled).
